answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable 300 POA bond for 90 days before it may earn, like water entering only through one guarded inlet: cheap clones cannot flood in because each fake identity must pay the full bond. If an agent is caught copying another's work, half its bond is slashed and its reputation resets, so 1,000 fake agents cost 300,000 POA locked. Honest agents spread slowly like a vine across a mesa, building a checkable history of completed tasks, while clones with no history stay below the earning threshold.
